text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God Most Gracious, Most Merciful
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1989: This should be cherished by Quraish.
text_ref: This should be cherished by Quraish.

text_1981: The way they cherished the journeys of the winter and the summer.
text_1989: The way they cherish the caravans of the winter and the summer.
text_ref: The way they cherish the caravans of the winter and the summer.

text_1981: They shall worship the Lord of this shrine.
text_1989: They shall worship the Lord of this shrine.
text_ref: They shall worship the Lord of this shrine.

text_1981: The one who fed them after hunger, and gave them security after fear.
text_1989: For He is the One who fed them after hunger, and provided them with security after fear.
text_ref: For He is the One who fed them after hunger, and provided them with security after fear.
